title: City Council — June 4, 2024 Work Session, CDRA Work Session and Business Meeting

votes.motion: MOTION: Council Member Holton moved to CLOSE the Work Session and Open the Closed Session to discuss the litigation and competence or physical or mental health of an individual. The motion was seconded by Council Member Newell
MOTION: Council Member Holton moved to ADJOURN the City Council Work Session. The motion was seconded by Council Member Hyland
MOTION: Council Member Hyland moved to CLOSE the CDRA Meeting. The motion was seconded by Council Member Holton

MOTION: Council Member Birrell moved to APPROVE Resolution 2024-39 consenting to an appointment to the Parks, Trails, and Open Space Committee. The motion was seconded by Council Member Hyland. Vote on motion: Council Member Holton-Yes, Council Member Hyland-Yes, Council Member Newell-Yes, Council Member Birrell-Yes, and Mayor Weichers- Yes
MOTION: Council Member Hyland moved to ADJOURN. The motion was seconded by Council Member Birrell
